newsitem.title: GERMANY: Big test to come for Telekom stock - Deutsche.
newsitem.headline: Big test to come for Telekom stock - Deutsche.

text.p: The biggest test for shares in Deutsche Telekom AG, floated last November in Germany's biggest-ever initial public offering, is still to come, Rolf Breuer, chief executive-designate of Deutsche Bank AG, said.

Breuer told news channel n-tv in an interview to be aired on Sunday that the expiry of a six-month period after the flotation -- during which speculative profits are taxed in Germany -- would be the "decisive test" for Telekom shares.

The end of the six-month period in May could encourage profit-taking in Telekom stock, which closed on Friday at 33.37 marks -- around initial trading levels and up from the original issue price of 28.50 marks per share.
Breuer, in remarks released by n-tv ahead of broadcast, said he considered the prospects for Telekom shares good.
He added he considered it a success that most investors had not rushed out to cash in short-term speculative profits.
Deutsche Bank was one of the global coordinators for the original $13 billion stock offering.
